player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between the Craft room, Exercise room, Bathroom, and Attic without realizing I had already visited all unique rooms. I kept moving until I returned to the start, assuming unvisited rooms remained, but I never checked the set of visited nodes against the total count of unique rooms found. Next time, after every move, I will explicitly count the unique nodes in my `graph["nodes"]` list. If the count of unique nodes equals the number of times I have been told "You have made a step and entered [Room Name]" (excluding the start), I will immediately output "DONE" instead of taking another step, ensuring I stop exactly when the map is fully explored.
